<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Vaulter\Media\Configuration;

use Illuminate\Contracts\Config\Repository;
use Vaulter\Configuration\ConfigValidator;
use Vaulter\Contracts\Cas\BlobStore;
use Vaulter\Contracts\Cas\ContentStore;
use Vaulter\Contracts\Cas\StorageDriver;
use Vaulter\Exceptions\Configuration\InvalidConfigurationException;
use Vaulter\Media\Cas\FlysystemStorageDriver;
use Vaulter\Media\Cas\Sha256ContentStore;

final readonly class MediaConfig
{
    public function __construct(private Repository $config) {}

    public function disk(): string
    {
        $value = $this->config->get(key: 'vaulter-media.disk', default: 'local');

        return is_string($value) && $value !== '' ? $value : 'local';
    }

    public function dedupScope(): string
    {
        $value = $this->config->get(key: 'vaulter-media.dedup.scope', default: 'tenant');

        if ($value === 'storage') {
            $value = 'drive';
        }

        return in_array($value, ['global', 'tenant', 'drive'], strict: true) ? $value : 'tenant';
    }

    public function gcGraceHours(int $override = 0): int
    {
        $value = $override > 0 ? $override : $this->config->get(key: 'vaulter-media.gc.grace_hours', default: 24);

        $hours = is_numeric($value) ? (int) $value : 24;

        return max($hours, 1);
    }

    public function orphanGraceHours(int $override = 0): int
    {
        $default = $this->config->get(key: 'vaulter-media.gc.grace_hours', default: 24);

        $value = $override > 0 ? $override : $this->config->get(key: 'vaulter-media.gc.orphan_grace_hours', default: $default);

        $hours = is_numeric($value) ? (int) $value : 24;

        return max($hours, 1);
    }

    /** @return class-string<ContentStore> */
    public function contentStore(): string
    {
        $class = $this->config->get(key: 'vaulter-media.content_store', default: Sha256ContentStore::class);

        if (!is_string($class)) {
            throw new InvalidConfigurationException('[Vaulter] vaulter-media.content_store must be a class name.');
        }

        ConfigValidator::assertImplements(key: 'vaulter-media.content_store', class: $class, base: ContentStore::class);

        return $class;
    }

    /** @return class-string<StorageDriver> */
    public function storageDriver(): string
    {
        $class = $this->config->get(key: 'vaulter-media.storage_driver', default: FlysystemStorageDriver::class);

        if (!is_string($class)) {
            throw new InvalidConfigurationException('[Vaulter] vaulter-media.storage_driver must be a class name.');
        }

        ConfigValidator::assertImplements(key: 'vaulter-media.storage_driver', class: $class, base: StorageDriver::class);

        return $class;
    }

    /** @return class-string<BlobStore> */
    public function blobStore(): string
    {
        $class = $this->config->get(key: 'vaulter-media.blob_store', default: \Vaulter\Media\Cas\BlobStore::class);

        if (!is_string($class)) {
            throw new InvalidConfigurationException('[Vaulter] vaulter-media.blob_store must be a class name.');
        }

        ConfigValidator::assertImplements(key: 'vaulter-media.blob_store', class: $class, base: BlobStore::class);

        return $class;
    }
}

        ->and($config->resumableEnabled())->toBeTrue()
        ->and($config->model('upload_session'))->toBe(UploadSession::class)

    expect($config->maxFileSize())->toBe(1025)
        ->and($config->resumableEnabled())->toBeFalse()
        ->and($config->nameMaxLength())->toBe(100);
});

    $repository = new Repository;
    $config = new DriveConfig($repository);

    expect($config->resumableEnabled())->toBeTrue();

    $repository->set('vaulter-drive.uploads.resumable.enabled', $value);

    expect($config->resumableEnabled())->toBe($enabled);

    'false' => [false, false],

    'true string' => ['true', true],
    'string one' => ['1', true],

100→  When both old ID keys exist, `ids.default` retains its previous precedence over
  `id_type`. Update `panels` classes to `ProfileProvider` if necessary; incompatible classes
  fail with a `vaulter:make:profile` hint.
- `dedup.scope = storage` maps to `drive`. The old `uploads.max_bytes` and
  `drive.max_upload_kb` limits are compared in bytes (`max_upload_kb × 1024`);
  different legacy limits log a warning and the smaller wins. A legacy `false`
  for either `features.uploads` or `uploads.tus.enabled` disables resumable uploads.
- If `share_token_generator` and `share.token_generator` both exist, a custom
  value wins over the other shipped default. Two different custom values throw
  `InvalidConfigurationException`; keep only `sharing.token_generator`.
110→- `vaulter.middleware` now sets only the authenticated stack. Put middleware for
  public links and signed hub callbacks in `routes.middleware.public` and `.hub`.

  and file revisions are always enabled. `features.blobs`, `features.versions`
  and `features.document_versions` are removed. Their old `false` values now warn
  and are ignored; uninstall the Documents package if you do not want its surface.
- Comments default to **true** in `vaulter-documents.comments.enabled`. Explicit
  legacy `features.comments = false` is translated and stays false; configure the
  canonical key to disable comments in a fresh installation. Collaboration stays
  opt-in via `vaulter-documents.collaboration.enabled`.

  warn and are ignored. The tenant column is always `tenant_id`; separators are
  rejected by fixed code. Keep `table_names` only for the physical-table upgrade;
  `DatabaseConfig::legacyTable()` is its sole reader.
- `vaulter.enabled_document_types` and `vaulter.features.spreadsheets` remain core
  keys in this transition, read by `DocumentsConfig`. Exporters remain a
  **format → FQCN map** under `vaulter-documents.exporters`, not a list.
- Move TipTap allow-list overrides from core to `config/vaulter-documents.php`:
  `vaulter.tiptap.extra_nodes` becomes `vaulter-documents.tiptap.extra_nodes`,
  `extra_marks` becomes `vaulter-documents.tiptap.extra_marks`,
130→  `extra_attributes` becomes `vaulter-documents.tiptap.extra_attributes`, and
  `url_attributes` becomes `vaulter-documents.tiptap.url_attributes`. These settings
  remain additive to the built-in allow-list and retain URL-scheme validation.
- For old published keys, exact built-in FQCN strings shipped in 0.2 are translated
  to canonical implementations. Custom FQCN strings remain unchanged; update their
  PHP imports, base classes and contracts to canonical names yourself.

Install the separate bridge before selecting `VAULTER_PERMISSION_DRIVER=azgard`:
150→
```bash
composer require axioma-studio/vaulter-azgard
```

Its discovered provider registers `vaulter.access.permission_drivers.azgard` when the host
has not explicitly set that key, and binds the real guard adapter. Remove the former
AzGuard driver entry from a published core config unless it is an intentional custom
override. Without the bridge, `azgard` is an unknown driver and P2.5 boot validation raises
`InvalidConfigurationException`.

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Vaulter\Configuration;

use Illuminate\Contracts\Config\Repository;
use Illuminate\Support\Arr;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log;
use Vaulter\Exceptions\Configuration\InvalidConfigurationException;
use Vaulter\Profiles\ProfileProvider;

final class ConfigNormalizer
{
    /** @var array<string, string> */
    private array $defaultPaths = [];

    /** @var array<string, array<string, mixed>> */
    private array $defaults = [];

    /** @var array<string, true> */
    private array $warned = [];

    public function registerDefaults(string $root, string $path): void
    {
        if (($this->defaultPaths[$root] ?? null) !== $path) {
            unset($this->defaults[$root]);
        }
        $this->defaultPaths[$root] = $path;
    }

    /** @return array<string, array<string, mixed>> */
    public function packageDefaults(): array
    {
        $defaults = [];
        foreach ($this->defaultPaths as $root => $path) {
            $this->defaults[$root] ??= $this->loadDefaults($path);
            $defaults[$root] = $this->defaults[$root];
        }

        return $defaults;
    }

    /** @param array<string, array<string, mixed>> $packageDefaults */
    public function normalize(Repository $config, array $packageDefaults): void
    {
        $original = $this->stringKeyedEntries($config->all());
        $defaults = $this->stringKeyedEntries(Arr::dot($packageDefaults));

        foreach (self::keyMap() as $legacy => $canonical) {
            $root = explode('.', $canonical)[0];
            if (!array_key_exists($root, $packageDefaults) || !Arr::has($original, $legacy) || isset($this->warned[$legacy])) {
                continue;
            }

            $value = $this->translate(Arr::get($original, $legacy));
            if ($legacy === 'vaulter.dedup.scope' && $value === 'storage') {
                $value = 'drive';
            }
            if ($legacy === 'vaulter.id_type') {
                $value = Arr::get($original, 'vaulter.ids.default') ?: ($value === 'ulid' ? 'ulid' : 'bigint');
            }
            if ($legacy === 'vaulter.max_versions') {
                $value = Arr::get($original, 'vaulter.versions.max', $value);
            }
            if (in_array($legacy, ['vaulter.share_token_generator', 'vaulter.share.token_generator'], true)) {
                $top = $this->translate(Arr::get($original, 'vaulter.share_token_generator'));
                $nested = $this->translate(Arr::get($original, 'vaulter.share.token_generator'));
                $default = Arr::get($packageDefaults, $canonical);
                if ($top !== null && $nested !== null && $top !== $default && $nested !== $default && $top !== $nested) {
                    throw new InvalidConfigurationException('[Vaulter] Conflicting legacy sharing token keys "vaulter.share_token_generator" and "vaulter.share.token_generator".');
                }
                $value = $nested !== null && $nested !== $default ? $nested : ($top ?? $nested);

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Vaulter\Tests\Support;

use PhpParser\Error;
use PhpParser\Node;
use PhpParser\Node\Expr;
use PhpParser\Node\Name;
use PhpParser\Node\Scalar\String_;
use PhpParser\Node\Stmt;
use PhpParser\NodeTraverser;
use PhpParser\NodeVisitor\NameResolver;
use PhpParser\ParserFactory;
use RecursiveDirectoryIterator;
use RecursiveIteratorIterator;
use RuntimeException;
use Throwable;

/**
 * Bounded syntax guard, independent of class_exists() and Pest's class inventory.
 * Comments and ordinary data strings are not dependencies. Literal class strings
 * are checked only at conventional container/reflection/class-consuming calls.
 * Variables, computed callables and runtime class-string propagation need review;
 * this guard intentionally does not attempt PHP data-flow or execute scanned files.
 */
final class ConfigurationArchitectureGuard
{
    public const PUBLISHED_V02_SHA256 = '72004b4a083bc6ec7510290671de9e1157c15212c9c86279a05366dd80a51ce2';

    private const PACKAGES = ['core', 'drive', 'documents', 'media', 'filament', 'azgard'];

    private const RETIRED_CLASSES = [
        'vaulter\\support\\config',
        'vaulter\\support\\gateconfig',
        'vaulter\\support\\spatieconfig',
        'vaulter\\drive\\support\\uploads\\uploadmodels',
        'vaulter\\drive\\uploads\\uploadmodels',
        'vaulter\\documents\\documentsmodels',
    ];

    /** @return list<string> */
    public function scanPackages(string $packagesDirectory): array
    {
        $violations = [];
        $fixture = rtrim($packagesDirectory, '/').'/core/tests/Fixtures/config/vaulter-0.2.php';
        try {
            self::assertPublishedV02Fixture($fixture);
        } catch (Throwable $error) {
            $violations[] = $error->getMessage();
        }

        foreach (self::PACKAGES as $package) {
            $owner = rtrim($packagesDirectory, '/').'/'.$package;
            foreach (['src', 'tests', 'config', 'database', 'routes'] as $scope) {
                $directory = $owner.'/'.$scope;
                $required = in_array($scope, ['src', 'tests', 'config'], true);
                if (!file_exists($directory)) {
                    if ($required) {
                        $violations[] = $directory.':1: cannot inventory required package scope';
                    }

                    continue;
                }

                try {
                    if (!is_dir($directory) || !is_readable($directory)) {
                        throw new RuntimeException('scope must be a readable directory');
                    }

                    $files = new RecursiveIteratorIterator(
                        new RecursiveDirectoryIterator($directory, RecursiveDirectoryIterator::SKIP_DOTS),
                        RecursiveIteratorIterator::SELF_FIRST,
                    );
                    $phpFiles = 0;
                    foreach ($files as $file) {
                        $path = $file->getPathname();
                        // RecursiveDirectoryIterator does not follow directory links.
                        // Fail closed rather than silently omitting their PHP files.
                        if ($file->isLink() && $file->isDir()) {
                            $violations[] = $path.':1: linked directory cannot be inventoried';

                            continue;
                        }
                        if ($file->isDir() || strtolower($file->getExtension()) !== 'php') {
                            continue;
                        }
                        $phpFiles++;
                        $contents = @file_get_contents($path);
                        if ($contents === false) {
                            $violations[] = $path.':1: cannot read PHP file';

                            continue;
                        }
                        $allowConfig = in_array($scope, ['tests', 'config'], true)
                            || ($scope === 'src' && str_starts_with($path, $owner.'/src/Configuration/'));
                        array_push($violations, ...$this->scanSource($contents, $path, $allowConfig));
                    }
                    if ($required && $phpFiles === 0) {
                        $violations[] = $directory.':1: required package scope contains no PHP files';
                    }
                } catch (Throwable $error) {
                    $violations[] = $directory.':1: inventory failed: '.$error->getMessage();
                }
            }
        }

        sort($violations);

        return array_values(array_unique($violations));
    }

    public static function assertPublishedV02Fixture(string $path): void
    {
        $contents = @file_get_contents($path);
        if ($contents === false || !hash_equals(self::PUBLISHED_V02_SHA256, hash('sha256', $contents))) {
            throw new RuntimeException($path.':1: published v0.2 fixture must match pinned SHA-256 '.self::PUBLISHED_V02_SHA256);
        }
    }

    /** @return list<string> */
    public function scanSource(string $source, string $path, bool $allowConfig = false): array
    {
        try {
            $nodes = (new ParserFactory)->createForNewestSupportedVersion()->parse($source) ?? [];
            $traverser = new NodeTraverser(new NameResolver);
            $nodes = $traverser->traverse($nodes);
        } catch (Throwable $error) {
            $line = $error instanceof Error ? max(1, $error->getStartLine()) : 1;

            return [$path.':'.$line.': cannot parse/resolve PHP: '.$error->getMessage()];
        }

        $violations = [];
        foreach ($nodes as $node) {
            $this->inspect($node, $path, $allowConfig, $violations);
        }

        return array_values(array_unique($violations));
    }

    /** @param list<string> $violations */
    private function inspect(Node $node, string $path, bool $allowConfig, array &$violations): void
    {
        if ($node instanceof Stmt\Use_ || $node instanceof Stmt\GroupUse) {
            foreach ($node->uses as $use) {
                if (($node->type | $use->type) !== Stmt\Use_::TYPE_NORMAL) {
                    continue;
                }
                $name = $node instanceof Stmt\GroupUse ? $node->prefix.'\\'.$use->name : (string) $use->name;
                $this->checkClass($name, $use, $path, $violations);
            }

            return;
        }

        if ($node instanceof Name\FullyQualified) {
            $this->checkClass((string) $node, $node, $path, $violations);
        }
        if ($node instanceof Stmt\Class_ || $node instanceof Stmt\Interface_ || $node instanceof Stmt\Trait_ || $node instanceof Stmt\Enum_) {
            if ($node->namespacedName !== null) {
                $this->checkClass((string) $node->namespacedName, $node, $path, $violations);
            }
        }
        if ($node instanceof Expr\FuncCall && $node->name instanceof Name) {
            $function = strtolower((string) $node->name);
            if (!$allowConfig && $function === 'config') {
                $violations[] = $path.':'.$node->getStartLine().': direct config() outside owning src/Configuration';
            }
            $arguments = match ($function) {
                'app', 'resolve', 'class_exists', 'interface_exists', 'trait_exists', 'enum_exists' => [0 => ['abstract', 'class']],
                'class_alias' => [0 => ['class'], 1 => ['alias']],
                'is_a', 'is_subclass_of' => [0 => ['object_or_class'], 1 => ['class']],
                default => [],
            };
            $this->checkArguments($node->args, $arguments, $path, $violations);
        }
        if (($node instanceof Expr\MethodCall || $node instanceof Expr\StaticCall || $node instanceof Expr\NullsafeMethodCall) && $node->name instanceof Node\Identifier) {
            $arguments = match (strtolower((string) $node->name)) {
                'make', 'makewith', 'resolve' => [0 => ['abstract']],
                'bind', 'bindif', 'singleton', 'singletonif', 'scoped', 'scopedif' => [0 => ['abstract'], 1 => ['concrete']],
                'instance' => [0 => ['abstract']],
                default => [],
            };
            $this->checkArguments($node->args, $arguments, $path, $violations);
        }
        if ($node instanceof Expr\New_ && $node->class instanceof Name) {
            $arguments = match (strtolower((string) $node->class)) {
                'reflectionclass', 'reflectionmethod', 'reflectionproperty' => [0 => ['objectOrClass', 'class']],
                default => [],
            };
            $this->checkArguments($node->args, $arguments, $path, $violations);
        }
        if (($node instanceof Expr\New_ || $node instanceof Expr\StaticCall || $node instanceof Expr\StaticPropertyFetch || $node instanceof Expr\ClassConstFetch || $node instanceof Expr\Instanceof_) && $node->class instanceof Expr) {
            $this->checkLiteral($node->class, $path, $violations);
        }

        foreach ($node->getSubNodeNames() as $field) {
            // Namespace declarations and function/constant names are not class refs.
            if ($field === 'name' && ($node instanceof Stmt\Namespace_ || $node instanceof Expr\FuncCall || $node instanceof Expr\ConstFetch)) {
                continue;
            }
            $value = $node->{$field};
            foreach (is_array($value) ? $value : [$value] as $child) {
                if ($child instanceof Node) {
                    $this->inspect($child, $path, $allowConfig, $violations);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * @param array<Node\Arg|Node\VariadicPlaceholder> $args
     * @param array<int, list<string>>                 $positions
     * @param list<string>                             $violations
     */
    private function checkArguments(array $args, array $positions, string $path, array &$violations): void
    {
        foreach ($args as $position => $argument) {
            if (!$argument instanceof Node\Arg) {
                continue;
            }
            foreach ($positions as $index => $names) {
                if (($argument->name === null && $position === $index)
                    || ($argument->name !== null && in_array((string) $argument->name, $names, true))) {
                    $this->checkLiteral($argument->value, $path, $violations);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    /** @param list<string> $violations */
    private function checkLiteral(Expr $expression, string $path, array &$violations): void
    {
        $value = $this->literalString($expression);
        if ($value !== null) {
            $this->checkClass($value, $expression, $path, $violations);
        }
    }

    private function literalString(Expr $expression): ?string
    {
        if ($expression instanceof String_) {
            return $expression->value;
        }
        if ($expression instanceof Expr\BinaryOp\Concat) {
            $left = $this->literalString($expression->left);
            $right = $this->literalString($expression->right);

            return $left !== null && $right !== null ? $left.$right : null;
        }

        return null;
    }

    /** @param list<string> $violations */
    private function checkClass(string $name, Node $node, string $path, array &$violations): void
    {
        if (in_array(strtolower(ltrim($name, '\\')), self::RETIRED_CLASSES, true)) {
            $violations[] = $path.':'.$node->getStartLine().': retired configuration helper '.$name;
        }
    }
}

<?php declare(strict_types=1);

namespace PhpParser\Node\Stmt;

use PhpParser\Node\Stmt;
use PhpParser\Node\UseItem;

class Use_ extends Stmt {
    /**
     * Unknown type. Both Stmt\Use_ / Stmt\GroupUse and Stmt\UseUse have a $type property, one of them will always be
     * TYPE_UNKNOWN while the other has one of the three other possible types. For normal use statements the type on the
     * Stmt\UseUse is unknown. It's only the other way around for mixed group use declarations.
     */
    public const TYPE_UNKNOWN = 0;
    /** Class or namespace import */
    public const TYPE_NORMAL = 1;
    /** Function import */
    public const TYPE_FUNCTION = 2;
    /** Constant import */
    public const TYPE_CONSTANT = 3;

    /** @var self::TYPE_* Type of alias */
    public int $type;
    /** @var UseItem[] Aliases */
    public array $uses;

    /**
     * Constructs an alias (use) list node.
     *
     * @param UseItem[] $uses Aliases
     * @param Stmt\Use_::TYPE_* $type Type of alias
     * @param array<string, mixed> $attributes Additional attributes
     */
    public function __construct(array $uses, int $type = self::TYPE_NORMAL, array $attributes = []) {
        $this->attributes = $attributes;
        $this->type = $type;
        $this->uses = $uses;
    }

    public function getSubNodeNames(): array {
        return ['type', 'uses'];
    }

    public function getType(): string {
        return 'Stmt_Use';
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

use Illuminate\Config\Repository;
use Illuminate\Container\Container;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Application;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log;
use Vaulter\Configuration\ConfigNormalizer;
use Vaulter\Exceptions\Configuration\InvalidConfigurationException;
use Vaulter\Media\VaulterMediaServiceProvider;
use Vaulter\Models\Drive\Drive;
use Vaulter\Profiles\DefaultProfile;
use Vaulter\Support\RandomShareTokenGenerator;
use Vaulter\VaulterServiceProvider;

/** @param Closure(): void $callback @return list<string> */
function collectConfigurationDeprecations(Closure $callback): array
{
    $messages = [];
    set_error_handler(static function (int $severity, string $message) use (&$messages): bool {
        if ($severity === E_USER_DEPRECATED) {
            $messages[] = $message;

            return true;
        }

        return false;
    });
    try {
        $callback();
    } finally {
        restore_error_handler();
    }

    return $messages;
}

it('normalizes each legacy key and emits a deprecation once', function (string $legacy, string $canonical, mixed $value, mixed $expected): void {
    $config = new Repository;
    $config->set($legacy, $value);
    $root = explode('.', $canonical)[0];
    $normalizer = new ConfigNormalizer;
    $messages = collectConfigurationDeprecations(static function () use ($normalizer, $config, $root): void {
        $normalizer->normalize($config, [$root => []]);
        $normalizer->normalize($config, [$root => []]);
    });
    expect($config->get($canonical))->toBe($expected)
        ->and($messages)->toBe(['[Vaulter] Config key "'.$legacy.'" is deprecated; use "'.$canonical.'".']);
})->with('legacy configuration keys');

it('rejects different canonical and legacy values', function (string $legacy, string $canonical, mixed $value, mixed $expected): void {
    $config = new Repository;
    $config->set($legacy, $value);

data: for a leading backslash in PHP 5.8 versus 5.7. The changed dependency closure may use 5.8, but the guard only lives in core. Need to verify Use type handling and confirm whether code-guidance runs under root vendor at 5.7.

FileContent.raw_output:
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

use Vaulter\Tests\Support\ConfigurationArchitectureGuard;

$root = dirname(__DIR__, 4);
require $root.'/vendor/autoload.php';

$violations = (new ConfigurationArchitectureGuard)->scanPackages($root.'/packages');
$retired = '/Support\\\\Config\b|GateConfig|SpatieConfig|UploadModels|DocumentsModels|vaulter-cas/';

foreach (['docs/guide', 'docs/reference', 'docs/ru'] as $scope) {
    $directory = $root.'/'.$scope;
    $files = new RecursiveIteratorIterator(new RecursiveDirectoryIterator($directory, RecursiveDirectoryIterator::SKIP_DOTS));
    foreach ($files as $file) {
        if (!$file->isFile()) {
            continue;
        }
        $contents = file_get_contents($file->getPathname());
        if ($contents === false) {
            throw new RuntimeException('Cannot read '.$file->getPathname());
        }
        foreach (explode("\n", $contents) as $line => $text) {
            if (preg_match($retired, $text) === 1) {
                $violations[] = $file->getPathname().':'.($line + 1).': retired helper/file in current documentation';
            }
        }
    }
}

echo $violations === [] ? "Code Guidance D24: no violations; fixture integrity verified.\n" : implode("\n", $violations)."\n";
exit($violations === [] ? 0 : 1);

rather than `require-dev`; installing either also installs Drive and its Media
backend. Update your Composer lock accordingly. Filament Move now requires
workspace creation access and Create on the destination, including the storage
root. A denied move leaves the node in place and shows "Move not allowed".

wins for protected routes, including an empty list. Public shares and signed hub
callbacks use their own `public` and `hub` stacks; metrics are appended once to
all stacks. Replace PHP calls to `Config::middleware()` with the corresponding
`authenticatedMiddleware()`, `publicMiddleware()` or `hubMiddleware()`.

1475→
**What changed.** These seams previously let the container's generic
`Illuminate\Contracts\Container\BindingResolutionException` ("Target [...] is not
instantiable.") propagate — a message with no mention of "vaulter" or which composer package to
install. They now catch it and throw `Vaulter\Exceptions\Support\MissingPackageException`
1480→instead, naming the missing contract and the exact `composer require` to run.

**Why.** The docblocks of `HandlerRegistry`/`NodeHandlerResolver` already claimed a "fails
loudly with an install hint" — this makes that true.

**Who is affected.** Only a host that specifically caught `BindingResolutionException` around
these calls to detect a missing satellite package — that catch no longer matches
(`MissingPackageException` still extends the base `RuntimeException`-rooted `VaulterException`,
so a broad `catch (\Throwable)`/`catch (\Exception)` is unaffected).

1490→### Dead `StorageAdapter` seam removed: `Contracts\Cas\StorageAdapter`, `Support\DefaultStorageAdapter`, `config('vaulter.storage_adapter')` (P4.4 / F-P3.1-03)

**What changed.** `Vaulter\Contracts\Cas\StorageAdapter`, its no-op default implementation
`Vaulter\Support\DefaultStorageAdapter`, the `config('vaulter.storage_adapter')` key and
`Config::storageAdapterClass()` are removed entirely.

**Why.** This was a fully-declared seam (contract + default implementation + config-bound FQCN
resolver) left over from an earlier, pre-CAS milestone — nothing in the package ever resolved
`Config::storageAdapterClass()` or bound `StorageAdapter` in any provider. Real binary-attachment
persistence goes through the independent, actually-wired `StorageDriver`/`ContentStore` CAS seam
1500→(`packages/media`). Keeping the dead seam around was a DX trap: a host reading the contract and
binding an implementation against it got a class that was never called.

**Who is affected.** Only a host that bound its own `StorageAdapter` implementation via
`config('vaulter.storage_adapter')` or referenced `Vaulter\Contracts\Cas\StorageAdapter` /
`Vaulter\Support\DefaultStorageAdapter` directly — given the seam was never invoked, this is
expected to be nobody in practice.

**What you must check.** If you implemented a `StorageAdapter` expecting it to handle binary
attachment storage, remove the config key/binding and use the `StorageDriver`/`ContentStore`
1510→CAS contracts (`config('vaulter.cas.storage_driver')` / `config('vaulter.cas.content_store')`)
instead — that is the seam real persistence has always gone through.

### Node name search now escapes `%`/`_`/`\`; cycle detection now on for tree reads (P4.2 / F-P1.8-03, F-P4.2-02)

1→# Upgrade Guide

This file documents breaking changes and how to migrate through them. Entries are ordered
newest-first. See `CHANGELOG.md` for the full list of changes per release; this file only covers
changes that require action from consumers of the package.

## Unreleased

### Package-owned configuration and typed access (AD26, P2.5)
10→
Merge your published configuration into the new package files before removing the
old keys. Keep host overrides; publishing with `--force` would replace them.
The publication tags are `vaulter-config`, `vaulter-media-config`,
`vaulter-drive-config`, `vaulter-documents-config`, `vaulter-azgard-config` and
`vaulter-filament-config`. Rename the old Media file `config/vaulter-cas.php` to
`config/vaulter-media.php`, then move the core-owned disk/dedup/GC values into it.
Drive and Documents now merge under their own roots, rather than `vaulter.models`,
`vaulter.handlers` and `vaulter.exporters`.

20→Configuration compatibility applies to keys, not PHP imports. Replace the removed helpers:

| Removed API | Replacement |
|---|---|
| `Vaulter\Support\Config` | `Vaulter\Configuration\VaulterConfig` plus section classes |
| `Vaulter\Support\GateConfig`, `Vaulter\Support\SpatieConfig` | `Vaulter\Configuration\AccessConfig` |
| `Vaulter\Drive\Support\Uploads\UploadModels` | `Vaulter\Drive\Configuration\DriveConfig::model(string)` |
| `Vaulter\Documents\DocumentsModels` | `Vaulter\Documents\Configuration\DocumentsConfig::model(string)` |

Inject the `final readonly` configuration singletons into services. In models,
30→migrations and static contexts use `app(DatabaseConfig::class)`, etc. The classes
read `Illuminate\Contracts\Config\Repository` on every call, so test-time
`config()->set()` remains visible. `VaulterConfig` exposes `database()`, `ids()`,
`tenancy()`, `access()`, `routes()`, `listing()`, `sharing()`, `downloads()`,
`webhooks()` and `observability()`. Direct Vaulter-key reads outside `Configuration`
are prohibited in package code by architecture tests. There are no PHP class aliases.

The normalizer runs after installed package defaults merge and before provider boot.
Each old key emits `E_USER_DEPRECATED` once. An explicitly customized canonical value
that differs from the translated old value throws
40→`Vaulter\Exceptions\Configuration\InvalidConfigurationException`; equal values only
warn. Default canonical values can be replaced by old published values. Module keys
are normalized only when their owning package is installed. Deprecated key support
is removed in 1.0.

| Deprecated key | Canonical key |
|---|---|
| `vaulter.connection` | `vaulter.database.connection` |
| `vaulter.table_prefix` | `vaulter.database.table_prefix` |
| `vaulter.id_type / vaulter.ids.default` | `vaulter.ids.strategy` |
50→| `vaulter.tenant.enabled` | `vaulter.tenancy.enabled` |

`config/vaulter-media.php`, then move the core-owned disk/dedup/GC values into it.
Drive and Documents now merge under their own roots, rather than `vaulter.models`,
`vaulter.handlers` and `vaulter.exporters`.

Configuration compatibility applies to keys, not PHP imports. Replace the removed helpers:

| Removed API | Replacement |
|---|---|
| `Vaulter\Support\Config` | `Vaulter\Configuration\VaulterConfig` plus section classes |
| `Vaulter\Support\GateConfig`, `Vaulter\Support\SpatieConfig` | `Vaulter\Configuration\AccessConfig` |
| `Vaulter\Drive\Support\Uploads\UploadModels` | `Vaulter\Drive\Configuration\DriveConfig::model(string)` |
| `Vaulter\Documents\DocumentsModels` | `Vaulter\Documents\Configuration\DocumentsConfig::model(string)` |

Inject the `final readonly` configuration singletons into services. In models,
migrations and static contexts use `app(DatabaseConfig::class)`, etc. The classes
read `Illuminate\Contracts\Config\Repository` on every call, so test-time
`config()->set()` remains visible. `VaulterConfig` exposes `database()`, `ids()`,
`tenancy()`, `access()`, `routes()`, `listing()`, `sharing()`, `downloads()`,
`webhooks()` and `observability()`. Direct Vaulter-key reads outside `Configuration`
are prohibited in package code by architecture tests. There are no PHP class aliases.

The normalizer runs after installed package defaults merge and before provider boot.
Each old key emits `E_USER_DEPRECATED` once. An explicitly customized canonical value
that differs from the translated old value throws
`Vaulter\Exceptions\Configuration\InvalidConfigurationException`; equal values only
warn. Default canonical values can be replaced by old published values. Module keys
are normalized only when their owning package is installed. Deprecated key support
is removed in 1.0.

| Deprecated key | Canonical key |
|---|---|
| `vaulter.connection` | `vaulter.database.connection` |
| `vaulter.table_prefix` | `vaulter.database.table_prefix` |
| `vaulter.id_type / vaulter.ids.default` | `vaulter.ids.strategy` |
| `vaulter.tenant.enabled` | `vaulter.tenancy.enabled` |

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Vaulter\ValueObjects\Cas;

use InvalidArgumentException;

final readonly class BlobScope
{
    private function __construct(private string $kind, private ?string $id = null, private ?string $legacySegment = null) {}

    public static function global(): self
    {
        return new self('global');
    }

    public static function tenant(string $id): self
    {
        return self::identified('tenant', $id);
    }

    public static function drive(string $id): self
    {
        return self::identified('drive', $id);
    }

    public static function legacy(string $segment): self
    {
        if ($segment === 'global') {
            return new self('global', legacySegment: $segment);
        }

        // Historical releases also emitted ULID segments; preserve their layout.
        if (preg_match('/^([st])(null|\d+|[0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{26})$/D', $segment, $matches) !== 1) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('Invalid legacy CAS scope segment.');
        }

        return new self($matches[1] === 's' ? 'drive' : 'tenant', $matches[2] === 'null' ? null : $matches[2], $segment);
    }

    public static function forUpload(string $dedupScope, ?string $tenantId, string $storageId): self
    {
        return match ($dedupScope) {
            'global' => self::global(),
            'tenant' => $tenantId === null ? self::global() : self::tenant($tenantId),
            'drive', 'storage' => self::drive($storageId),
            default => throw new InvalidArgumentException('Unknown CAS dedup scope.'),
        };
    }

    public function key(): string
    {
        if ($this->kind === 'global') {
            return 'global';
        }

        return $this->id === null ? 'legacy:'.$this->legacySegment : $this->kind.':'.$this->id;
    }

    public function segment(): string
    {
        if ($this->legacySegment !== null) {
            return $this->legacySegment;
        }

        if ($this->kind === 'global') {
            return 'g';
        }

        $id = $this->id ?? throw new InvalidArgumentException('Missing CAS scope identifier.');
        $encoded = preg_match('/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$/D', $id) === 1
            ? $id : '~'.rtrim(strtr(base64_encode($id), '+/', '-_'), '=');

        return ($this->kind === 'drive' ? 'd-' : 't-').$encoded;
    }

    public static function fromSegment(string $segment): self
    {
        if ($segment === 'g') {
            return self::global();
        }

        if (preg_match('/^([td])-(~?[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,128})$/D', $segment, $matches) !== 1) {
            return self::legacy($segment);
        }

        $encoded = $matches[2];
        $id = str_starts_with($encoded, '~') ? base64_decode(strtr(substr($encoded, 1), '-_', '+/'), true) : $encoded;
        if ($id === false) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('Invalid encoded CAS scope identifier.');
        }

        $scope = $matches[1] === 'd' ? self::drive($id) : self::tenant($id);
        if ($scope->segment() !== $segment) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('Noncanonical CAS scope segment.');
        }

        return $scope;
    }

    public function isLegacy(): bool
    {
        return $this->legacySegment !== null;
    }

    public function dedupScope(): string
    {
        return $this->kind;
    }

    public function tenantId(): ?string
    {
        return $this->kind === 'tenant' ? $this->id : null;
    }

    public function storageId(): ?string
    {
        return $this->kind === 'drive' ? $this->id : null;
    }

    private static function identified(string $kind, string $id): self
    {
        // Keep the canonical path within the reconciler's bounded segment grammar.
        if ($id === '' || strlen($id) > 96) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('CAS scope identifiers must contain 1–96 bytes.');
        }

        return new self($kind, $id);
    }
}

<?php declare(strict_types=1);

namespace PhpParser\Node;

use PhpParser\Node;
use PhpParser\NodeAbstract;
use PhpParser\Node\Stmt\Use_;

class UseItem extends NodeAbstract {
    /**
     * @var Use_::TYPE_* One of the Stmt\Use_::TYPE_* constants. Will only differ from TYPE_UNKNOWN for mixed group uses
     */
    public int $type;
    /** @var Node\Name Namespace, class, function or constant to alias */
    public Name $name;
    /** @var Identifier|null Alias */
    public ?Identifier $alias;

    /**
     * Constructs an alias (use) item node.
     *
     * @param Node\Name $name Namespace/Class to alias
     * @param null|string|Identifier $alias Alias
     * @param Use_::TYPE_* $type Type of the use element (for mixed group use only)
     * @param array<string, mixed> $attributes Additional attributes
     */
    public function __construct(Node\Name $name, $alias = null, int $type = Use_::TYPE_UNKNOWN, array $attributes = []) {
        $this->attributes = $attributes;
        $this->type = $type;
        $this->name = $name;
        $this->alias = \is_string($alias) ? new Identifier($alias) : $alias;
    }

    public function getSubNodeNames(): array {
        return ['type', 'name', 'alias'];
    }

    /**
     * Get alias. If not explicitly given this is the last component of the used name.
     */
    public function getAlias(): Identifier {
        if (null !== $this->alias) {
            return $this->alias;
        }

        return new Identifier($this->name->getLast());
    }

    public function getType(): string {
        return 'UseItem';
    }
}
